notesZh: 鼠标移入数字或时钟周围区域显示按钮，移向按钮时保持显示，移出整个时钟后隐藏。ZIP 版新增 itch.io 单款皮肤购买及激活/恢复；已激活皮肤可离线使用，皮肤内容继续在线更新。
notesEn: Hover over the digits or surrounding clock area to show controls; they stay visible as you move onto a button and hide when you leave the whole clock. Adds individual itch.io skin purchases and activation/restoration to the ZIP edition. Activated skins work offline, with online skin content updates.
